title: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel

entities.name: Saint Traft
entities.description: A young priest of the Church of Avacyn from Stensia, famed demon slayer who became a saint and was killed by the demon Withengar; he later became a geist.

entities.name: Geist of Saint Traft
entities.description: The restless spirit of Saint Traft, who haunts Innistrad accompanied by a guardian angel.

entities.name: Guardian Angel of Saint Traft
entities.description: An angel of Avacyn who perched on Traft's roof, arrived too late to save him, and watches over his geist.

entities.name: Withengar
entities.description: A demon-lord who tricked and destroyed Saint Traft and was pushed back by the angels.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The Archangel of Innistrad whose angels aid Traft; she has gone missing.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church in which Traft served as priest.

entities.name: Demon cultists
entities.description: Hooded cultists led by a priest who trap Saint Traft with a girl hostage.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane plagued by vampires, geists and demons.

entities.name: Shadowgrange
entities.description: Human village in Stensia where Traft's cottage stood.

entities.name: Needle's Eye
entities.description: Infamous mountain pass in Stensia beset by geists and vampires, where Traft is trapped.

entities.name: Ashmouth
entities.description: A sulfurous pit leading to the bowels of the world, where Traft fought demons.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: City with a Shrine of Traft.

events.summary: Traft and Avacyn's angels hunt demons together along the Ashmouth; he is recognized as a saint.
events.quote: Traft's exploits became famous, and he became recognized as a saint before his fortieth year.

events.summary: Traft returns to Shadowgrange to find an angel on his roof and his wards destroyed.
events.quote: The wards above his door had been scratched out and neutralized, and the door hung ajar.

events.summary: Traft finds a demonic dagger through a map and a bloody message demanding he come without angels.
events.quote: A jagged, demonic dagger had been jammed into the table right through the map, stabbing into the infamous mountain pass known as Needle's Eye.

events.summary: Traft lies to the angel, telling her it is nothing, and rides to Needle's Eye alone.
events.quote: "It's nothing," he told her. "I'll handle it."

events.summary: Traft fights through the pass, losing his horse, and reaches the crest where cultists dance around a girl.
events.quote: had to sacrifice his horse to escape a vampire that had gone mad from blood rage

events.summary: The cult leader threatens the girl and casts a spell that fills the pass with dark fog.
events.quote: "You call your angels, and she dies," said the cultist.

events.summary: Traft refuses to call on Avacyn and cuts down cultists blindly in the fog, slaying the lead cultist.
events.quote: Within the dark fog, Traft's blade found cultist after cultist.

events.summary: Traft realizes he has been tricked into killing cultists with the bone dagger, an act of sacrifice serving a demon.
events.quote: But to Traft's horror, his hand did not hold his sword, but the bone dagger of the cult-priest

events.summary: Traft frees the girl from the possession spell and sends her home.
events.quote: Saint Traft rushed to unbind the child.

events.summary: Withengar rises from the crack in the earth; Traft finally calls on Avacyn's angels.
events.quote: Saint Traft finally said his withheld prayer, calling on the aid of the angels of Avacyn.

events.summary: The angel arrives too late; Withengar destroys Saint Traft, then is pushed back by angels.
events.quote: The demon Withengar had destroyed the living saint, the famed slayer of demonkind.

events.summary: Traft never passes into the Blessed Sleep and becomes a geist.
events.quote: After Traft was buried, he never passed into the Blessed Sleep, and instead became a geist to haunt the world.

relations.quote: Traft was a young priest in the Church of Avacyn.

relations.note: destroyed him after the trap at Needle's Eye
relations.quote: The demon Withengar had destroyed the living saint

relations.note: demonkind laid a trap for the demon slayer
relations.quote: Traft, the celebrated slayer of fiends, had become a thorn in the side of demonkind.
wherever that restless ghost appears, so does his warden, his guardian angel.
Saint Traft returned home to the human village of Shadowgrange in Stensia.
